title: Activation
$comment: Engine -> runner. Built per fired trigger, partitioned by destination addr. Ships the FULL recorded payload, not just the field that flipped. Source: both artifacts.

partition_addr.description: Destination runner addr this activation is routed to.

fired_triggers.description: Trigger ids that evaluated truthy, for strategy context / debugging.

payload.description: Signal values delivered at activation, assembled as-of the triggering event's sequence number. Keyed 'signal_id.field' -> value. The strategy runs against this subslice.

layout_hash.description: Must equal the resident strategy's manifest layout_hash; the harness refuses the activation otherwise. The per-message cost of one string buys the guarantee that layout drift is always a refusal, never a misread.
